label: AI Insight UI — Smart City
info:
Smart City data backend, REAL data only. Queries Trino's gold layer:
  - gold.streetlight_zone_hourly  → /streetlights, /streetlights/:zone/{current,history}
  - gold.traffic_pattern_hourly   → /traffic,      /traffic/:zone/{current,history}
  - gold.event_impact_daily       → /events,       /events/:zone/{current,history}
  - gold.weather_hourly           → /city-weather/{current,history}

The Trino tables are populated by the gold-layer aggregation flow (NiFi/ORCE)
from Kafka feeds emitted by the simulation engine. They are zone-level hourly
aggregates — there is no per-light or per-vehicle granularity, so the
`/streetlights/:id/...` endpoints take a `zone_id` as the path parameter
(reflecting what the gold table actually exposes).

If a Trino query returns no rows the endpoint returns an empty array with
`metadata.source = 'gold.<table>'` and `metadata.note = 'no rows in window'`,
rather than fabricating data. FAP §10 (subflow design) + §12 (explicit
failure) — never imply success when no data is available.

FAP §9 actions: smart-city.{zones.list,zones.detail,streetlights.list,traffic.summary,events.recent}.
